snippet.title: Shelley Jackson, Patchwork Girl.  Part 1
snippet.description: Part 1 of Shelley Jackson's traversal of her hypertext poem, Patchwork Girl, for the Pathfinders project, led by Dene Grigar and Stuart Moulthrop and sponsored by the National Endowment for the Humanities. The event took place on October 18 at the Electronic Literature Lab (ELL) at Washington State University Vancouver.
